scheme_name: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Permanent Partial Disability Gujarat
description:
The Group Accident Insurance Scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) was launched by the Government of India on September 10, 2020. 

This scheme aims to provide financial security to fishers and fish farmers in the event of accidental death or permanent disability. 

The initiative is part of a broader effort to enhance the livelihoods of those involved in the fisheries sector. 

The PMMSY is a flagship scheme that seeks to bring about sustainable development in the fisheries sector. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme specifically targets individuals engaged in fishing activities across the country. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to offer insurance coverage to fishers and fish farmers. 

The scheme aims to provide a safety net for individuals who may face unforeseen accidents while pursuing their livelihoods. 

The insurance coverage under this scheme includes a sum of INR 2 lakh for accidental death. 

In the case of permanent total disability, the same amount of INR 2 lakh is provided. 

For permanent partial disability, the insurance payout is based on the extent of disability. 

The payout for permanent partial disability can range from INR 1 lakh to INR 2 lakh. 

The scheme is designed to cover a wide range of fishing-related activities. 

Eligible beneficiaries include registered fishers and fish farmers. 

The eligibility criteria specify that individuals must be engaged in fishing activities. 

There is no specific age limit mentioned for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, beneficiaries must be part of a registered group or cooperative. 

The income criteria for eligibility are not explicitly defined. 

The application process for the Group Accident Insurance Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must first register with the local fisheries department. 

They need to provide documentation proving their engagement in fishing activities. 

Required documents typically include identity proof and proof of fishing activity. 

Once registered, individuals can apply for the insurance coverage. 

The application must be submitted to the local fisheries department office. 

The insurance coverage is provided through selected insurance companies. 

The disbursement of benefits occurs upon the occurrence of an accident. 

Beneficiaries or their families must file a claim with the insurance provider. 

The claim process requires submission of relevant documents. 

These documents may include a death certificate or medical reports for disability claims. 

The timeline for processing claims can vary based on the insurance provider. 

Generally, claims are processed within 30 to 45 days of submission. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries under the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

The contact details for the Department of Fisheries can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of a larger initiative to boost the fisheries sector in India. 

The PMMSY aims to increase fish production to 22 million metric tons by 2024-2025. 

It also aims to create 55 lakh direct and indirect jobs in the fisheries sector. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a crucial component of this broader vision. 

The scheme has been well-received by the fishing community. 

It provides a sense of security to individuals who often work in hazardous conditions. 

The insurance coverage helps mitigate the financial impact of accidents. 

The scheme is expected to enhance the overall welfare of fishers and fish farmers. 

The Government of Gujarat has also taken steps to promote this scheme at the state level. 

State officials conduct awareness programs to educate fishers about the benefits of the scheme. 

The scheme is aligned with the government's goal of doubling farmers' incomes by 2022. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of the fishing community. 

The scheme also encourages more individuals to engage in sustainable fishing practices. 

By providing financial security, the scheme aims to reduce the economic vulnerability of fishers. 

The insurance coverage is a critical support mechanism for families of fishers. 

In the event of an accident, the financial assistance can help cover immediate expenses. 

The scheme also aims to promote a culture of safety within the fishing community. 

By raising awareness about safety measures, the scheme seeks to reduce the incidence of accidents. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is an essential part of the PMMSY framework. 

It reflects the government's recognition of the importance of the fisheries sector. 

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all eligible fishers. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The scheme is expected to evolve based on the changing needs of the fishing community. 

Overall, the Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY is a significant welfare initiative. 

It provides much-needed support to one of the most vulnerable segments of the population. 

The scheme is a step towards ensuring that fishers can work with peace of mind. 

The financial assistance offered through the scheme is a crucial safety net. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the livelihoods of fishers through such initiatives. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a vital part of the larger narrative of social welfare in India. 

It underscores the importance of protecting those who contribute to the nation's food security. 

The scheme is a model for similar initiatives in other sectors. 

By focusing on the welfare of fishers, the government aims to create a more resilient and sustainable fisheries sector. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a significant milestone in this journey.
